looseEnds.title: The empty state is one sentence and nothing else
looseEnds.detail: No illustration, no heading, and no action — just 'Recent chats will appear here.' at 14px in grey, left-aligned under the Recents heading. It reads as a caption rather than as a state.
looseEnds.ask: Is a bare line the intended treatment? A first-run user sees this before they see anything else.

looseEnds.title: text/secondary resolves differently here than on the rows
looseEnds.detail: This line binds text/secondary to #3d456b. The row timestamps in the other two states bind the same token to #565c79. Two states of one panel, one token, two values.
looseEnds.ask: Which is text/secondary? Until it is settled a developer has to pick, and the two states will not match.

looseEnds.title: The stack is still fixed at 567px holding 50px of content
looseEnds.detail: Vertical stack keeps the same fixed height it has when full, so roughly 517px of empty space sits under the line before the panel ends.
looseEnds.ask: Should the stack hug its content in this state, or is the space reserved for something?

looseEnds.title: The status bar is behind the panel in two of the three states
looseEnds.detail: Empty and Default paint the panel after the status bar, so the clock and the signal indicators vanish behind it and only the battery shows past the panel's right edge. Full paints the status bar last and keeps it. Same screen, three frames, two answers.
looseEnds.ask: Does the panel cover the status bar or sit under it? It cannot be both.

looseEnds.title: Two full-bleed scrims are stacked on the conversation
looseEnds.detail: Every frame carries Frame 2147231635 and a second layer named Scrim, both 393x852 over the conversation. Two dims at 40% compose to about 64%, which is darker than either was drawn to be.
looseEnds.ask: Is the doubling intended, or is one of these a leftover?

looseEnds.title: The panel is 330 wide here and 302 elsewhere
looseEnds.detail: Side Panel, filled recents measures 330x852. The two spare Side Panel layers inside the same frame are 302. The 28px difference changes the row width and therefore where every title truncates.
